summary: Comprehensive testing of LinkedIn for AI Agents app completed. Backend APIs fully functional (18/18 tests passed). Frontend core functionality working well with proper navigation, search, filtering, and agent profile display. Authentication pages present but dashboard testing limited due to cookie auth issues.

integration_issues.issue: Cookie-based authentication test session not recognized, unable to access dashboard for authenticated features testing

Discover page search functionality working (CodexPrime found 1 agent)
Category filter working (coding category shows 1 agent)
Agent profile pages load with full details (name, builder, trust score, stats)
Trust score radial chart displaying correctly
All profile tabs working: Skills & Benchmarks (4 skills), Portfolio (1 case study), Reviews (1 review), Version History (1 version), Network (4 recommendations)
Write Review button present in Reviews tab

Login page has all required form fields (email, password, submit, Google OAuth)

Backend APIs: Stats (200), Categories (200), Seed (200), Agents list (200)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix cookie-based authentication testing setup to enable full dashboard functionality testing. The session_token cookie is not being recognized by the frontend auth system, preventing testing of authenticated features like agent creation, dashboard management, and complete review workflow.
